summary.text: Karen Anderson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 19 since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Anderson has been affiliated with Concerned Women for America of ND, the Walsh County Farm Bureau and the board of the Pregnancy Help Center, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Human Services Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
